title: Al Mudeef Centre Abu Dhabi
hero.text: Long-term care and rehabilitation, in partnership with the Zayed Authority for People of Determination

text: Al Mudeef Centre is operated through a partnership with the Zayed Authority for People of Determination, with Cambridge Hospital providing clinical management and rehabilitation expertise. The centre supports children and adults with complex physical and cognitive conditions through long-term care and structured rehabilitation, delivered by licensed multidisciplinary teams in a therapeutic, residential-style environment.

Through a coordinated, multidisciplinary approach, the centre provides comprehensive rehabilitation and ongoing clinical support. With an emphasis on family involvement and continuity of care, Al Mudeef Centre plays an important role in supporting patients who require sustained medical and rehabilitative care.
